clue.text: Will is offensive about male organ

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other, the offensive wrapped around the organ

parts.note: the Tet offensive of 1968 in the Vietnam War, so offensive gives TET
the stamen is the pollen-bearing male organ of a flower

explanation.surface: A rude remark about a man's private parts is being made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Male organ' points the mind at anatomy, but it is the botanical stamen.
explanation.definitionFit: A testament is a will, as in 'last will and testament', the legal document leaving property.

clue.text: Instructor's rebuke to non-commissioned soldiers

parts.note: tut is a little exclamation of rebuke or disapproval
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not commissioned officers

explanation.surface: A drill instructor tells off the lower ranks.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Instructor's' is read as 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is a private teacher, someone who instructs a pupil or small group.

clue.text: Medical instruments head of urology inserted into awkward places

indicators.note: inserted into means the first letter is put inside the rearranged letters
awkward signals that the letters of places are arranged clumsily into a new order
head of picks out the first letter of urology

explanation.surface: A urologist's instruments are being put into uncomfortable parts of the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkward' turns PLACES into SPECLA, and U is slipped in to give SPECULA.
explanation.definitionFit: Specula, plural of speculum, are instruments for opening a body cavity for examination.

clue.text: Bad year for philosopher …

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters of year are spoilt and rearranged

explanation.surface: It was a poor twelve months for a thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: A. J. Ayer was a British philosopher, known for logical positivism.

clue.text: … and so ogre is slaughtered

indicators.note: slaughtered suggests the word ogre is hacked about into a new order

explanation.surface: Continuing a story: and so the monster is killed.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this to the previous clue's surface; 'and' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for therefore, used in English meaning 'so' or 'hence'.

clue.text: Over half shunned pawnbroker's sign

definitions.meaning: a cricket over has six deliveries, so half an over is that many balls, here left alone by the batsman
the traditional emblem hung outside a pawnshop is a cluster of three golden spheres

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is six balls bowled; a batsman may 'leave' (shun) a delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: Three golden spheres hanging outside a shop are the traditional emblem of a pawnbroker in Britain.

clue.text: Sue taken in by woman's disguises

indicators.note: taken in by means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Ms is the title for a woman
to sue is to petition or ask, as in suing for peace

explanation.surface: Someone named Sue is fooled by another woman's disguises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sue' looks like a name, but it is the verb to petition.
explanation.definitionFit: Masks are coverings that hide the face, so they are disguises.

clue.text: Bond vehicle with singular sails

parts.note: Moonraker is an Ian Fleming James Bond novel and film, a vehicle for Bond
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: James Bond's car comes with unusual sails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vehicle' looks like a car or boat, but it is a book or film starring Bond.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonrakers are small light sails set high above the skysail on a square-rigged ship.

clue.text: Made disparaging remarks as Sri Lankan openers played poor strokes

indicators.note: openers are the first letters, as batsmen open an innings

parts.note: in cricket an edged shot comes off the edge of the bat, a poor stroke

explanation.surface: Sri Lanka's opening batsmen are taunted as they play badly.
explanation.walkthrough: To sledge, in cricket, is to taunt a batsman with insults on the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Sledging is cricket slang for verbally needling an opponent, so sledged means made insulting remarks.

clue.text: Celebrities ultimately covet a particular kind of gem

parts.note: celebrities are stars

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter of covet

parts.note: a particular one, a single specified example, so one

explanation.surface: Famous people really want a certain type of jewel.
explanation.definitionFit: A star stone is a gem such as a star sapphire showing a six-rayed light effect.

clue.text: A. Berg's great hope is to produce a musical drama

indicators.note: to produce suggests the letters are worked into something new

parts.note: the initial, name and S taken as written

explanation.surface: The composer Alban Berg hopes to write a great opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A. Berg' suggests the composer Alban Berg, but the letters are just fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: John Gay's 1728 ballad opera is a musical stage drama.

clue.text: German fired mortar to achieve victory

indicators.note: fired means the letter for German is sacked from the word

parts.note: grout is thin mortar used to fill gaps between tiles

explanation.surface: A German shell is fired to win the battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fired mortar' paints artillery, but 'fired' means dismissed: G leaves GROUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A rout is an overwhelming defeat, so from the winner's side a crushing victory.

clue.text: Reported charges for honours

indicators.note: reported signals a word that is spoken aloud

parts.note: pierages are fees for using a pier

explanation.surface: The fees mentioned are in return for titles.
explanation.definitionFit: Peerages are titles of nobility conferred as honours.

clue.text: Musical acrobatics could produce bad neck and ear

indicators.note: could produce suggests the letters are reworked to make something

explanation.surface: Gymnastic dancing to music may cause pain in neck and ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Breakdancing is an athletic street dance with spins and flips done to music.

clue.text: Left dog somewhere in Wales

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
a talbot is an old breed of hunting hound

explanation.surface: A dog was abandoned somewhere in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' reads as 'abandoned'; it is the nautical port side.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Talbot is a steel town in South Wales.

clue.text: Administer a horrid enema to be purged of this?

definitions.text: Administer a horrid enema to be purged of this?

indicators.note: administer suggests the letters are dosed out and rearranged
purged means the inside is cleared out, leaving the first and last letters of enema

explanation.surface: A nasty enema is given to clear out a bowel complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'purged' empties ENEMA to EA, which joins A HORRID in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose bowel movement is something an enema-style purge might be supposed to clear.

clue.text: Doctor lives to alleviate disease

parts.note: D is the dictionary abbreviation for doctor, as in degrees like DD
lives means is, exists
to temper is to moderate or soften

explanation.surface: A doctor lives to relieve illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Distemper is a viral disease of dogs and other animals.

clue.text: Tease and impersonate young man

parts.note: to kid is to tease
to do someone is to impersonate them

explanation.surface: Mocking and mimicking a young chap.
explanation.definitionFit: Kiddo is an informal address for a young person or lad.

clue.text: Russian regiment reaches Hawaii

parts.note: the SAS is the Special Air Service regiment
HA is an abbreviation for Hawaii

explanation.surface: A Russian army regiment gets to Hawaii.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Russian' is the definition: Sasha is a Russian pet name.
explanation.definitionFit: Sasha is a common Russian name, the diminutive of Alexander.

clue.text: Jock and Dicky, perhaps, hiding under small bed

indicators.note: hiding under puts the tie after the bed in a down light

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a dicky bow is a bow tie, so a kind of tie

explanation.surface: Two characters are hiding under a little bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jock and Dicky' look like two names; 'Jock' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Jock and Scottie are both informal names for a Scotsman.

clue.text: Give work to cleaner

indicators.note: work suggests the letters of cleaner are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Hand the job to the cleaner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give' reads as a verb, but it is the noun for slack or flexibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Give, as a noun, is flexibility or allowance, such as play in a mechanism.

clue.text: Gaseous element was corrosive, it's just emerged

parts.note: neon is a gaseous chemical element
ate, as acid eats into metal

explanation.surface: A chemistry note: a corrosive gas has just been released.
explanation.definitionFit: A neonate is a newborn baby, one that has just come out into the world.

clue.text: Freudian concept involving two aspects of personality, each ultimately theoretical

parts.note: the ego is one aspect of the Freudian psyche
the id is another aspect of the Freudian psyche

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of theoretical

explanation.surface: A psychoanalytic idea uses two parts of the mind and is theoretical.
explanation.definitionFit: In Freud, the standard of perfection the ego aims at, later the superego.

clue.text: Publish letters

definitions.meaning: to put up a notice or put online, make public
mail, items delivered by the Royal Mail

explanation.definitionFit: Post means to make public, as with a notice, and also mail delivered.

clue.text: Melody has tempo, edge and energy

parts.note: T is an abbreviation for tempo
a hem is the edge of cloth
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A tune has speed, bite and vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme is the main tune or melodic subject of a musical piece.

clue.text: Malayan glossary included Chinese philosophical concept

indicators.note: included means the letters sit inside the words Malayan glossary

explanation.surface: A Malay word list contains a Chinese idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Yang is the bright, active principle in Chinese philosophy, paired with yin.

clue.text: We meet king's successor

parts.note: we is he and I together
the second of the pair making we, the first person singular
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Royals assemble to greet the king's successor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'We' splits into HE and I, which 'meet', then R follows.
explanation.definitionFit: An heir is the person who will succeed to a title or estate.

clue.text: Show stoicism, like an Indian warrior?

definitions.meaning: to appear calm and brave in trouble
a Native American warrior is called a brave, so this is applying a warrior's face

explanation.definitionFit: Hiding distress behind a calm look is the idiom; the second reading puns on 'brave' meaning warrior.

clue.text: Rare Everglades bird is snared

indicators.note: snared means the letters are trapped within the words Rare Everglades

explanation.surface: A rare bird in a Florida swamp gets caught.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve is the female of the ruff, a wading bird.

clue.text: They are determined to look at gemstone

parts.note: tigers, in a figurative sense, are fierce, determined people
to eye is to look at

explanation.surface: Resolute people set out to inspect a jewel.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiger's eye is a golden-brown chatoyant quartz used as a gemstone.
